yaml.title: Import EEDTOY YAML
yaml.description: Choose exactly one import source. Manual YAML code and file paths are handled in separate dialogs so that a previously saved path can no longer block text input.

menu_options.yaml_file: Use a YAML file from the configuration directory

yaml_gateway.title: Select gateway block from YAML
yaml_gateway.description: The YAML export contains multiple gateways. Select the gateway block that belongs to this Home Assistant hub. The configuration is then saved and the integration is reloaded automatically.

yaml_text.title: Paste EEDTOY YAML code manually
yaml_text.description: Paste the complete EEDTOY YAML export here. Any previously saved file path is completely ignored in this dialog. After saving, the integration is reloaded automatically.

yaml_file.title: Import EEDTOY YAML file
yaml_file.description: The file must be located inside the Home Assistant configuration directory. Valid examples: /config/eedtoy.yaml, /homeassistant/eedtoy.yaml or eedtoy.yaml. Saved manual YAML text is not used in this dialog.

data.yaml_file_path: YAML file path in Home Assistant

diagnostics.title: Radio / bus diagnostics
diagnostics.description: Enables or disables the diagnostics buffer and sidebar entry globally for all ELTAKO gateways.

room_temperature_assignment.title: Assign room temperature sensor
room_temperature_assignment.description: Select the heating actuator that should receive a room-temperature source. Supported devices are FKS-SV and A5-10-06 FHK14/F4HK14/FAE14 actuators. The mapping is stored persistently by physical EnOcean ID.

room_temperature_source.title: Select temperature source
room_temperature_source.description: Choose the existing device/native or learned temperature source, or an external Home Assistant room-temperature sensor.

room_temperature_entity.title: Select external room temperature sensor
room_temperature_entity.description: Select a Home Assistant sensor entity with a temperature value. Suitable °C/°F sensors are supported regardless of the providing integration.
